notes: Entry is unpinned: 'the highest price over the last 50 trading days' (highest High vs highest Close) and the retest defined as price 'must pull back to the 10-day EMA' / 'touches or closes near the 10-day EMA' give no touch/nearness threshold, so careful implementers will pick different retest days. Exit is self-contradictory: rule 1 exits when price 'closes below the 10-day EMA' (dynamic) while risk management says 'the stop-loss should be set at the level of the 10-day EMA at the time of entry' (fixed). The sector filter ('only to technology sector stocks, especially in the cybersecurity and artificial intelligence sub-industries') and the volatility filter (ATR-14 'above the market average') require external sector data and cross-asset comparison, unimplementable on the single bound AAPL 1d feed (bench's own requirements row flags requires_multi_asset and requires_external_data). No hardcoded price levels (take-profit is a relative 10%), and indicator periods (EMA 10, 50-day high, 50-day volume average, ATR 14) plus sizing ('2% of total trading capital per trade') are stated.
